===Levels 62–99: Monkfish===
{{Main|Raw monkfish}}
Catching [[Raw monkfish|monkfish]] at the [[Piscatoris Fishing Colony]] is a profitable low-effort alternative to the faster methods. This method requires completion of [[Swan Song]]. Monkfish are caught with a [[small fishing net]].
